patches.description: Injects full Android Auto support into Petal Maps, including CarAppService, manifest declarations, and required resources. Also apply 'Anti-Repack Bypass' and 'Manufacturer Check Bypass' for full functionality on non-Huawei devices.
patches.name: Android Auto

patches.description: Neutralizes the native integrity check (SecurityDetect.irpj) that kills the process upon detecting APK re-signing.
patches.name: Anti-Repack Bypass

patches.description: Forces the Huawei manufacturer check to always return true, allowing non-Huawei devices to use the app.
patches.name: Manufacturer Check Bypass
